metadata.question: Did Donner Pass have over 40 inches of snow water equivelent in January to April, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Donner Pass, California (approximately 39.3°N, 120.3°W) - Time: January to April 2022 - Data: Need snow water equivalent (SWE) data - best source is MODIS Snow Cover or ERA5-Land for SWE 2. Masking strategy: - For SWE data, we need to aggregate/sum over the period or find maximum SWE - No cloud masking needed for reanalysis data like ERA5-Land 3. Logic: - Valid measurement > 40 inches → A (Yes) - Valid measurement ≤ 40 inches → B (No) - No data available → C1 - No valid pixels after processing → C2 - Invalid/null result → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const donnerPass = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.3, 39.3]); const startDate = '2022-01-01'; const endDate = '2022-04-30'; console.log("Analyzing SWE at Donner Pass (Jan-Apr 2022)"); // 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land has snow_depth_water_equivalent const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(donnerPass) .select('snow_depth_water_equivalent'); // in meters const imageCount = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("No ERA5-Land data available for this period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get maximum SWE over the period const maxSWE = era5.max(); // 4. Calculate SWE at Donner Pass const sweResult = maxSWE.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: donnerPass, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const sweMeters = sweResult.snow_depth_water_equivalent; // 5. Validation & Conversion if (sweMeters === null || sweMeters === undefined || isNaN(sweMeters)) { console.log("SWE calculation failed - invalid result"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert meters to inches (1 meter = 39.3701 inches) const sweInches = sweMeters * 39.3701; console.log(`Max SWE (Jan-Apr 2022): ${sweMeters.toFixed(3)} meters`); console.log(`Max SWE (Jan-Apr 2022): ${sweInches.toFixed(2)} inches`); console.log(`Threshold: 40 inches`); // 6. Final Answer if (sweInches > 40) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
